text: Developing a mobile app involves more than just writing code. First, you must consider responsive design, ensuring the interface adapts smoothly to different screen sizes, from small phones to large tablets. A major decision is choosing between native development, which uses platform-specific languages like Swift for iOS or Kotlin for Android, and cross-platform tools like Flutter or React Native that allow one codebase for both. After building, you have to publish the app through official app stores, which have strict review guidelines. Finally, performance is crucial; users quickly delete apps that are slow, laggy, or drain too much battery. A well-optimized app feels instant and responsive.
